name: comp-360
title: Directional Pan Tooltips
blurb: Four directional buttons in a cross layout, each with a tooltip showing…
description: 3x3 grid of arrow buttons arranged in a directional pad layout. Each button has a tooltip displaying the action and a keyboard shortcut in a kbd element.
use_when: Camera/pan controls, directional navigation, or mapping interfaces that benefit from visual arrangement.
avoid_when: Touch-only interfaces; the tight grid is hard to tap.
a11y: Buttons have proper aria-labels; tooltips show via hover only.
